info.title: Fourletters API - Hub (WebSocket)
info.description: Hub is a receive-only live relay. Clients open a WebSocket to receive already-accepted, E2E-encrypted payloads pushed by the Server via RabbitMQ.

/ws.description: Receive-only WebSocket channel for the fourletters Hub. The client authenticates with its Access JWT

subscribe.summary: Client receives a live payload from the Hub
subscribe.description: Relays a live payload to the client: a new message or a delivery/read/undecryptable notification.

publish.summary: Client sends a control frame to the Hub
publish.description: The Hub is otherwise receive-only; these are the only frames it acts on. Presence subscribe/unsubscribe manage which contacts' live state the client receives; typing announces the sender is typing; ping is an application-level liveness probe answered by a pong.

MessageEvent.name: MessageEvent
MessageEvent.title: Incoming Encrypted Message
MessageEvent.summary: A new encrypted message relayed live by the Hub

ReceiptEvent.name: ReceiptEvent
ReceiptEvent.title: Delivery / Read / Undecryptable Notification
ReceiptEvent.summary: A delivery, read, or undecryptable notification relayed live to the original sender

PresenceSubscribeCommand.name: PresenceSubscribeCommand
PresenceSubscribeCommand.title: Subscribe to Contact Presence
PresenceSubscribeCommand.summary: Start receiving a contact's online/typing state

TypingCommand.name: TypingCommand
TypingCommand.title: Typing
TypingCommand.summary: Announce the sender is typing in their active chat
